subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw accept `yieldToolResult(...)` and `AgentToolResult.control.type = "yield"` as the public plugin SDK contract for external-interaction tool handoffs?
rationale: This PR creates a new public plugin SDK and agent-core result control surface; review can assess mechanics, but maintainers must own the permanent contract shape.

options.title: Accept the result-control contract
options.body: Proceed with the generic result-level yield contract once live proof and CI validate the runtime path.

options.title: Keep yield internal for now
options.body: Decline the public SDK export and keep plugins on existing internal/session-owned yield paths until the API direction is settled.

options.title: Design a narrower interaction API
options.body: Ask for a specific plugin interaction, approval, or form-card API instead of exposing generic runtime controls on tool results.

recommendation.title: Accept the result-control contract
recommendation.body: Proceed with the generic result-level yield contract once live proof and CI validate the runtime path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent agent-runtime work and broad OpenClaw SDK/runtime history make steipete the best available owner for the API-direction call.
